messages:
alex (eng-platform): quick sync — runtime dashboards pushed to prod, need owners for alert rules + pager routing for the new metrics (latency, kv cache hit, token cost). cc @priya @maria
priya (eng-runtime): saw the dashboards, looks good. metric names are: runtime_request_p95_ms, runtime_error_rate_pct, kv_cache_hit_ratio, runtime_token_cost_per_req. all have route label 'route=runtime-prod'.
maria (eng-sre): can we define SLOs first? what are targets for p95 and error rate? need that to set burn-rate alerts.
lee (product): for GA customers: p95 <= 220ms, error_rate < 0.5%. For free tier we can be looser but product wants alerts only on prod-impacting regressions.
sam (eng-oncall): proposal for paging: P1 page when 1) 3h SLO burn rate > 1.5 and error_rate delta > 1% absolute, or 2) sustained p95 > 600ms for 15m. P2 page for single-metric threshold crossings that aren't burning. Thoughts?
alex (eng-platform): that's reasonable. prefer explicit expressions we can paste into Alertmanager/PD. I'll draft and we can iterate. Also want automatic routing by team tag: runtime -> runtime-oncall, infra -> infra-oncall.
priya (eng-runtime): telemetry already tags by team: team=runtime, env=prod. can route on label team=runtime.
maria (eng-sre): on burn-rate windows: use both 6h and 24h windows. 6h for fast detection, 24h for stability check. If both trigger, escalate to P1. Also add a flapping suppression: suppress if during a known rollout window (see alex).
lee (product): please include a high-signal alert for premium customers: p99 > 800ms -> SEV2 with product paging.
alex (eng-platform): draft alert rules (prom-style) — paste into convo for review:
```
ALERT RuntimeSLOBurn6h
  IF increase(runtime_slo_burn_ratio[6h]) > 1.5 and increase(runtime_error_rate_pct[6h]) > 1.0
  LABELS { severity="P1", team="runtime" }
  ANNOTATIONS { runbook="https://redwood/internal/runbooks/runtime-slo-burn" }

ALERT RuntimeHighP95
  IF runtime_request_p95_ms > 600
  FOR 15m
  LABELS { severity="P1", route="runtime-oncall" }
```
maria (eng-sre): ok but change increase() to rate() for error_rate metric to avoid spikes. and add for=10m to the burn alert to reduce noise.
sam (eng-oncall): remember canary/rollout windows — want an automatic silence during canary if rollout label present: rollout.phase="canary". we'll add a mute rule that respects deploy-bot annotations.
priya (eng-runtime): deploys already emit: deploy.annotations = { rollout_phase: "canary", canary_until: "2024-04-xxTxx:xxZ" } in telemetry. we can have alertmanager check that label.
alex (eng-platform): good — I'll add a silencing rule that blocks paging if rollout_phase=canary and add a small notification to #eng-oncall instead of PD.
lee (product): also add a low-noise channel for product (ops-) for non-paged alerts.
maria (eng-sre): final checklist: 1) concrete expressions (use rate()), 2) labels for routing (team, env, severity), 3) runbook links, 4) canary silence logic, 5) 6h/24h burn windows. once done we'll schedule a 30m dry-run with oncall.
alex (eng-platform): I'll push a draft config to the repo and tag reviewers. planning dry-run Thurs 10:30 PT. @sam can you confirm oncall availability?
sam (eng-oncall): available Thurs 10:30 PT. will bring rotation lead.
deploy-bot: Dashboard deploy completed: runtime-metrics-v2 -> prod by alex at 2024-04-04T16:12:08Z :white_check_mark:
alex (eng-platform): thanks — PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/alerts/!/pull/412 — reviewers: @maria @priya @sam. please comment on expressions. :thumbsup:
maria (eng-sre): quick note — add metrics cardinality check for kv_cache_hit_ratio; if label cardinality high, alert will be noisy. recommend using aggregate by cluster.
priya (eng-runtime): will update telemetry to expose cluster label and confirm cardinality.
alex (eng-platform): I'll incorporate changes and update the PR. after approvals we'll roll alert rules to staging, run the dry-run, then promote to prod. thanks everyone. :rocket:
